content:
jordan_acme: Hey team — onboarding hit a weird snag. Our mobile app started throwing a CircuitBreakerOpenError after a bunch of quick token refreshes. Users see brief failures to embed/complete requests.

maria_cs: sorry you're seeing this, jordan. Can you paste the top 3 log lines from the client around the failure window?

jordan_acme: pasted —
```
2026-04-02T14:02:12.123Z INFO init sdk v0.8.2
2026-04-02T14:02:12.456Z WARN preflight request failed 401 /v1/clients/preflight
2026-04-02T14:02:12.789Z ERROR CircuitBreakerOpenError: too many failures
```

jordan_acme: We also see a bunch of 429s in our edge logs right after the 401s. App then trips a local circuit breaker and stops trying for ~30s.

ashley_sdk: hmm — v0.8.2 had a regression where token refresh sometimes returns while a batch of preflight requests are already inflight. The SDK didn't dedupe preflight, so parallel preflight calls could explode under retry.

devon_infra: that matches: parallel preflight fanout -> a bunch of unauthenticated/partial requests -> server rate limiting -> client-side circuit breaker because retries happen too fast. Do you have retry settings on the client?

jordan_acme: default SDK config on our side. No custom retry/backoff.

ashley_sdk: ok here's the concrete bug: when the ephemeral token state is in ROTATING, the SDK allowed concurrent preflight attempts. One of them missed Authorization header during a race and returned 401. Client retried immediately; multiple retries + no jitter pushed token endpoint/edge into a short spike. We'll ship a patch to prevent concurrent preflight and add jitter to retries.

sam_support: for immediate mitigation, can you set these in your local SDK config?
```
clientConfig = {
  preflightConcurrency: 2,
  retry: { baseMs: 300, maxMs: 5000, jitter: true },
  tokenCacheTtlMs: 120000
}
```

jordan_acme: applying now. any server-side tweaks you can do while we test?

devon_infra: yes — we added a soft guard at the edge: if we detect repeat unauthenticated preflight from the same client within 10s, return Retry-After and a smaller rate-window header so clients back off instead of immediate circuit breaker. Also added a correlation header x-rw-request-id to help trace.

sre-bot: Incident note created: INC-2026-0478 — preflight fanout causing client circuit trips. Assigned to ashley_sdk + devon_infra.

maria_cs: jordan — would you be able to test the client change and let us know results in ~15m? We can coordinate a quick SDK patch release if it fixes it.

jordan_acme: patch applied — looks promising, no immediate 429s in the next couple attempts. App no longer trips the circuit. :thumbsup:

ashley_sdk: ok we'll cut v0.8.3 with two fixes: (1) preflight dedupe (mutex per endpoint) (2) default retry jitter + safer defaults. ETA ~2 hours.

sam_support: once v0.8.3 is out, please try rolling it to a subset of users and keep tokenCacheTtl at 2m for now. We'll follow up to relax later.

maria_cs: action items:
- ashley_sdk: release v0.8.3 and publish migration notes (ETA 2h)
- devon_infra: monitor edge rate-limit windows and confirm Retry-After headers are present (ETA 1h)
- jordan_acme: test 0.8.3 on staging then prod subset (ETA today)
- sam_support: stand by for rollback/patch assistance

jordan_acme: understood. Thanks for the rapid help. We were getting anxious before this thread.

maria_cs: we'll keep this open until you've validated on your side. I'll ping in 2h for a check-in. :white_check_mark:
